title: CTEs: queries you can read top to bottom
objectives: Name each step of a query with WITH
Compare against a figure worked out in an earlier step
Check each step on its own before trusting the whole

exercises.prompt: List the customers whose total 2026 spend is above the average customer's 2026 spend, with that total as total, in customer order.
hints: The starter has two mistakes. Which years does it add up, and what does its AVG average?
First work out each customer's 2026 total in a CTE. The average to compare with is the average of those totals, not of single orders.

WITH spend AS (SELECT customer, sum(amount) AS total FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY customer) SELECT customer, total FROM spend WHERE total > (SELECT avg(total) FROM spend) ORDER BY customer
